decisions.reason: As a newly launched two-component resin injection unit that fits the firm's core application-equipment business, it is likely to be given more time in the market unless demand is clearly weak.

This product also matches the firm's established resin-processing offering, though overlap with another new injection unit slightly raises the chance of later portfolio rationalization rather than an immediate withdrawal.
An automatic airless spray gun is close to the company's core coating technology and should benefit from its industrial customer base, making early discontinuation unlikely.
A manual airless spray gun is a standard, complementary product for the firm's users and service network, so management would normally keep it on the market after only one year.
An air-assisted airless spray gun line with several models suggests a broader commitment and customer coverage, which makes withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.

The data logger supports modern equipment monitoring and differentiation, but as a newer digital accessory outside the firm's main mechanical core it carries the highest review risk if uptake is limited.
